items.name: Cross-Platform Data Integration
items.description: Consolidated 10,000+ constituent records from three separate platforms into one CRM, cutting manual syncing for the sales team.
items.problem: AdaptX's sales team managed constituent data across three separate platforms (Zeffy, RunSignUp, JotForm), creating duplicate records and forcing manual, error-prone syncing into their CRM (Bloomerang).
responsibilities: Defined requirements for the cross-platform integration, translating business needs into technical specs
Architected an automated data integration pipeline using MCP and AI agents to sync the disparate platforms
Engineered an LLM-based deduplication layer and used Python/SQL to clean, restructure, and merge databases containing duplicates
Built a Notion workspace (Roadmap DB + Meeting Notes DB) to track project progress and decisions
Evaluated build-vs-integrate tradeoffs between continuing the CRM sync and building an in-house platform
Collaborated with engineering to align the mobile MVP with WCAG accessibility standards
items.impact: Unified 10,000+ constituent records across three platforms into a single source of truth, removing manual deduplication as a recurring bottleneck for the sales team.

items.name: TileTalk — Phonics Learning App
items.description: Product roadmap and requirements for an interactive phonics learning web app, replacing manual classroom tools.
items.problem: Teachers relied on manual, paper-based phonics tools that didn't scale well or fit modern classroom workflows.
responsibilities: Built the product roadmap, translating classroom needs into prioritized technical requirements
Led Agile sprint planning and cross-functional coordination between design and engineering
Conducted user workflow analysis to surface inefficiencies in manual classroom tools
Proposed and championed digital solutions that were adopted by the team
items.impact: Shipped a prioritized feature roadmap on schedule through Agile sprints, replacing manual classroom tools with a coordinated digital workflow.

items.name: FrontFoot
items.description: AI-powered scheduling assistant that turns constraints into a ready-made schedule using Google Calendar and Gemini.
items.problem: Manually building a schedule around existing commitments and personal constraints is slow and easy to get wrong.
responsibilities: Developed an AI-powered scheduling assistant integrating the Google Calendar API and Gemini API
Designed automation workflows to generate schedules based on user input and constraints
Implemented API-based system architecture for real-time task management and calendar sync
items.impact: Automated schedule generation and real-time calendar sync, removing manual back-and-forth scheduling.

items.name: ATE!
items.description: Mobile nutrition tracking app with an AI chatbot that analyzes food photos for gout patients.
items.problem: Gout patients need to track dietary triggers closely, but manual food logging is tedious and easy to abandon.
responsibilities: Designed system architecture and defined data models for the mobile nutrition tracking app
Implemented an AI chatbot for image-based food analysis tailored to gout patients
Applied Agile methodology to manage the development lifecycle and feature prioritization
items.impact: Replaced manual food logging with image-based AI analysis, lowering the effort needed to track dietary triggers.

items.name: MUSEEK
items.description: Competitive analysis and product definition for a mentorship-driven collaboration platform for independent musicians.
items.problem: Independent and student musicians had no affordable, mentorship-driven alternative to existing gig-marketplace platforms like Fiverr, Sonicbids, and SoundBetter.
responsibilities: Led competitive analysis (Fiverr, Sonicbids, SoundBetter), surfacing a market gap in affordable, mentorship-driven collaboration tools
Synthesized user research on independent/student musicians into product OKRs
Defined core features: discovery algorithm, analytics dashboard, messaging
items.impact: Turned market research into a scoped, validated feature set aligned to an identified market gap.

items.name: E-Commerce Growth Analytics
items.description: Analyzed e-commerce user behavior and built KPI dashboards that shaped a new business expansion decision.
items.problem: Leadership lacked real-time visibility into user retention and engagement, making it hard to evaluate whether to expand into a new business line.
responsibilities: Analyzed e-commerce user behavior (~500 monthly users) using Python and Excel to surface retention trends
Built automated dashboards tracking KPIs including session activity and repeat purchase rate
Presented data-driven insights to management
items.impact: Insights directly shaped management's decision to expand into halal-focused lodging services.
